document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The door swings inward, rattling on its hinges. The bulbous, 
misshapen thing lumbers into the room. Its lifeless, bulging 
eyes fix on you while its putrid mouth opens and closes silently.

Your hands shake abominably as you come face-to-face with 
the alien creature. Your eyes dart back and forth, staring first 
at it and then at the multitude of others like it that clog the 
doorway behind it. You cannot bring yourself to stare at the 
thing any longer, so you close your eyes and fire wildly.

When you open your eyes again, you see the bullet hole in 
the wall behind the creature. You missed. You don’t have time 
to collect your nerves for another shot as the monstrous thing 
throws itself at you and pins you to the ground.

With its cracked and broken fingernails, it claws open your 
throat as it wordlessly mouths praise to its dark god.
You are dead. Your visit to Esbury is over. THE END.
